visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black baseball cap, black t-shirt, and shorts sits on a white bench in a park-like setting with green bushes behind him. A black water bottle and a smartphone lie on the bench next to him. Another man in athletic gear enters the frame from the right. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor red running track where two men are jogging. One man is shirtless and highly muscular, wearing dark shorts, while the other wears a black t-shirt. The camera follows them from a side and front perspective as they run in daylight. (3) Both men stand on a grassy field next to the track, engaging in a conversation with active hand gestures. The muscular man is now shirtless, and the other man has his arms crossed or is pointing. (4) The video cuts back to the track showing them running from a low angle. The background includes a large stadium-like building and green trees under a bright sky. (5) After the exercise, the men are shown sitting or crouching on the track surface. The man in the black shirt is visibly sweating and lifts his shirt to show the moisture, while the shirtless man sits on the ground catching his breath.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the segment over a driving electronic beat. A transient whoosh SFX marks the visual cut to the track. (2) Sound of rhythmic, heavy footsteps on a hard athletic surface overlaps with upbeat BGM. Vocals shift to a casual conversational tone with audible breathiness due to physical exertion. (3) A sudden 'ding' sound effect transitions into a standing interview scene. Music volume ducks slightly to prioritize clear speech. (4) Vocal intensity increases as the speakers challenge each other; high-pitched laughter and exclamations are heard. (5) The master audio ends with heavy, labored breathing (ASMR-style exhaustion) as the music swells for a final beat and then hard cuts to silence.
